name: Yara Shahidi
bio: Yara Shahidi (born February 10, 2000) is an American actress and producer. She is known for  her roles in the films Salt (2010) and Peter Pan & Wendy (2023), as well as the role of Zoey Johnson on the television series Black-ish (2014–2022) and Grown-ish (2018–2024).
